The SRC-0004 obstruction groups are identified with Serre duals of the evaluation cokernels. The f=4 contribution vanishes by negative degree, and the degree-zero f=5 contribution is nonzero exactly when O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L.
The inclusion J subset I_e is scheme-theoretic: after pullback to e, the cokernel is a line bundle and all maximal minors vanish as sections, not merely on geometric points.
The set-theoretic support V(J)=e(B) follows from the degree-zero section criterion on Pic^0.
The reverse inclusion I_e subset J is supported by the intrinsic derivative/Serre-pairing calculation and Nakayama, and its conclusion is recorded in packet finding FND-0096.

The scheme-level identity Fit_0(coker phi_5)=a^*I_e is supported, but the asserted equality as closed substacks is not fully verified. Step 5 merely invokes smooth-locality and descent without supplying a checkable presentation of the universal ordered configuration stack or verifying descent of all constructions defining Z_ev and a^{-1}(e(B)).

The asserted source-backed isomorphism W_5 ~= omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D) depends on a CE relative-canonical normalization absent from the supplied SRC-0004 excerpt. FND-0105 expressly requires a source line for that normalization or conditionalization on GAP-Z-W5D; treating it as an established working-context fact does not discharge the dependency.

Riemann-Roch gives nonemptiness of the full Sym^6 Abel-Jacobi fibre. The attempt correctly avoids asserting ordered reduced nonemptiness or a coarse-moduli torsor and restricts the S_6-torsor statement to the stack.

theorem_statement: Theorem (scheme-theoretic identification of the balanced CE evaluation-failure locus at (g,n)=(6,6)). Work over locally Noetherian characteristic-zero bases, with the packet CE convention W_5 := (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(-5))|_C (the f_2=5 summand of (O(2) tensor gamma^*F^vee)|_C, not the O_{P^1}(5) summand of F). Let (pi:C->B, gamma) be a balanced tetragonal family of smooth genus-6 curves, let Gamma be a relative ordered Cartier divisor of degree 6 (a point of the ordered pairwise-distinct configuration stack), let 0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0 be the canonical filtered CE bundle (deg W_4=20, deg W_5=16), let phi: pi_*W -> pi_*(W|_Gamma) be the CE evaluation, and let Z_ev := V(Fit_0(coker phi)). Put L := W_5 tensor omega_{C/B}^{-1} (deg L=6) and let a: B -> Pic^0(C/B) classify O_C(Gamma) tensor L^{-1}. Then: (1) Fit_0(coker phi) = Fit_0(coker phi_5), where phi_5 is the W_5-evaluation (filtered reduction; no global splitting of W is used). (2) For the universal evaluation Phi of L_univ := omega_{C_P/P}(Gamma_P) tensor Poin^{-1} over P := Pic^0(C/B), one has Fit_0(coker Phi) = I_e, the ideal sheaf of the identity section e:B->P. (3) Z_ev = a^{-1}(e(B)) as closed substacks of the ordered configuration stack; equivalently Fit_0(coker phi_5) = a^*I_e. In particular, on every geometric fibre the points of Z_ev are exactly the ordered reduced degree-6 divisors Gamma with O_C(Gamma) isomorphic to W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}, and (Z_ev)_red equals the reduced Abel-Jacobi incidence. (4) Source-backed corollary clauses: on the balanced locus W_5 ~= omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D) for D a fibre of gamma, so the failure condition is Gamma in |omega_C(-D)|, equivalently D+Gamma canonical; and chi(L)=1 forces h^0(L)>=1, so the full Abel-Jacobi fibre in Sym^6 is nonempty on every smooth genus-6 geometric fibre (reduced-support ordered nonemptiness is NOT asserted). Exclusions: no monomorphism into M_{6,6}; no image/closure/component/dimension/stabilizer claim in M_{6,6}; no h^0 stratification; no unbalanced-tetragonal failure construction; no global splitting W=W_4+W_5 over the base; no identification of the relative linear system with Proj(pi_*L); no closedness claim for the reduced-support open; no coarse-moduli torsor claim; no statement about the exact target group.
